name: IATI activity data (via d-portal)
provides: Activities, commitments, disbursements, budgets, sectors and implementing organisations for AFD, KfW (via BMZ), FMO, Invest International, DGGF, Atradius DSB, the EBRD, the European Commission (DG INTPA, ECHO, FPI) and World Bank trust funds.
licence: Each publisher's open licence (mostly CC BY 4.0 or ODbL), registered on the IATI Registry

name: IATI regional activities
method: Full publisher files read page by page, monthly
provides: Africa-wide, Sub-Saharan, West and Central African activities of the Commission and KfW.

name: EIB signed loans (country and regional lists)
method: JSON behind the EIB's project pages, monthly
provides: Signed loans by country since 1999, and regional loans for Africa, West Africa and Central Africa.
licence: Public website; reuse with attribution (EIB legal notice)

name: Proparco project list and project pages
provides: Projects with country, year, amount, instrument, client and E&S category.

name: BIO investment portfolio
provides: Investments by country with amount, date and type.

name: DEG investments database (CSV export)
provides: Commitments since 2021 with country, amount, instrument and E&S category.

name: Finnfund investments
provides: Investments by country with amount bands.

name: Impact Fund Denmark investments
provides: Investments by country.

name: COFIDES projects
provides: Projects by country with sector and instrument.

name: OeEB projects at a glance
provides: Projects naming a Franc Zone country, with volume and date.

name: EU Emergency Trust Fund for Africa programmes
provides: EU contribution, locations, duration, theme and implementing partner of each programme.

name: ElectriFI and AgriFI projects
provides: Deals with country, year, instrument and amount.

name: EU-Africa Infrastructure Trust Fund grants
method: Annual report 2019 table and grant list (static)
provides: Every grant with countries, net amount, type, lead financier and status (2019 annual report: eib.org).

name: EU blending operations approved by the Commission
provides: Blending grants with country, lead financier, total project cost and EU contribution; used to tag deals already counted and to add missing ones.

name: Curated deals from public sources
provider: Press releases, annual reports and specialist press
method: Hand-checked, each deal links its own source
provides: Deals by BGK, KUKE, SACE, CDP, EIFO, Credendo, Bpifrance Assurance Export and Swedfund that no data feed covers.

name: Your manual entries
provides: Deals you add from information requests and reports; each row needs a source link.

name: Programme sources
provider: European Commission country pages, EEAS, UN, institutions
method: Hand-checked, each programme links its own source
provides: Team Europe Initiatives, Global Gateway flagships, EU envelopes and national programmes.

name: World Bank projects
provides: IBRD/IDA projects for the non-EU comparison.

name: AIIB project list
provides: Projects for the non-EU comparison.

name: ECB reference exchange rates
provides: Monthly average rates used to convert every amount to euros; XOF and XAF use the fixed peg of 655.957.
licence: ECB statistics, free reuse with attribution

name: IATI sector codes
provides: Names of the OECD-DAC sector codes, grouped into the tracker's ten sectors.

name: Base map and software
provides: Country shapes (Natural Earth, public domain; Crimea redrawn as part of Ukraine), the 3D globe and the shape decoder (MIT and ISC licences).

name: EU Financial Transparency System
provides: Who receives EU budget money each year, including AFD, GIZ and Expertise France as implementers: the best cross-check for EU funds implemented by member-state agencies.

name: OECD Creditor Reporting System
provides: Official development finance by agency since the 1970s: the route to fill 1999-2010.

name: DFI Transparency Tool
provides: How openly each development finance institution discloses: explains the gaps in this tracker.

name: Team Europe tracker
provides: Official names and members of Team Europe Initiatives; only public pages are cited in this tracker.
